compliance_claim.quote: While there's a regular size of the Aer Carry-On we prefer the Small version, as it's more compatible with the most popular airlines.
compliance_claim.hedge: Sometimes, bag manufacturers make bags that are meant to be used as a carry on but are slightly too large to be used with some airlines. We recommend checking your specific airline before flying.
